body.text: A small matter, and not properly the business of this office, but I would rather you heard it from me than did not hear it at all.

{param:patron} gives us to understand that Your Grace has been difficult. He did not say it to me. He said it at a table of eleven, twice, and by Thursday it had reached the Marshal's clerk, who repeated it to me with the air of a man doing me a kindness.
I do not know what passed between you and I have not asked. I observe only that he is very widely acquainted, and that a name is a slow thing to build and a quick thing to spend.
Whatever the merits, the room has taken his side. It usually does. The man who is present is always the more persuasive.
